items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: That's how I took his place, you see.

ctx.x: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

So they asked me, he says, when my job finished, you see, when my job finished, they asked me if I wanted to stay in my room. I said, sure, and that was luck, you know, and I didn't want to go back to the state, you know. That was really jammed up in my king. I said, I jump on it, I said, sure, because he says, you see, we can't have him, Charlie, and so far, because his wife had already sent him a ticket, you know, the money for him to come back to New Orleans, and he took that money and drank it up. And so he…
How was the reception for your type of music? Good.
